title: Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Direct Use of Revenues, etc. of Overseas Diplomatic Missions
title_original: 재외공관 수입금 등 직접사용에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters necessary to enable the heads of diplomatic missions of the Republic of Korea abroad to directly use their revenues and any unspent balance of operating expenses of their offices within the budgets allocated to the respective diplomatic missions, pursuant to Article 2 of the Act on the Direct Use of Revenues, etc. of Overseas Diplomatic Missions.

Article 2 (Applications for Approval of Direct Use)
(1) Where the head of a diplomatic mission of the Republic of Korea abroad (hereinafter referred to as a "diplomatic mission") intends to directly use its revenues and the unspent balance of the operating expenses of the office (hereinafter referred to as "revenues, etc."), he or she shall obtain approval from the Minister of Foreign Affairs. [Amended on March 23, 2013.]
(2) To obtain approval under paragraph (1), the head of the diplomatic mission shall submit to the Minister of Foreign Affairs an application stating the following matters: [Amended on March 23, 2013.]
1. The amount of the revenues, etc. intended for use;
2. The revenue or expenditure budget items to which the revenues, etc. belong and the expenditure budget item for which they are to be used;
3. The most recent exchange rate of the currency of the country of residence.

Article 3 (Approval of Direct Use)
Upon receiving an application under Article 2 (2), the Minister of Foreign Affairs shall approve the direct use within the limits of the operating expenses allocated to the relevant diplomatic mission. [Amended on March 23, 2013.]

Article 4 (Substitute Payment for Amounts Used Directly)
When the Minister of Foreign Affairs grants approval under Article 3, the Minister shall require the disbursing officer under his or her jurisdiction to deduct, from funds to be disbursed to the relevant diplomatic mission, an amount corresponding to the amount approved for direct use, and to pay that amount into the National Treasury or deposit it under the relevant expenditure budget item. [Amended on March 23, 2013.]

Addendum <Presidential Decree No. 4259, November 14, 1969>
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Addendum to the Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade and Its Affiliated Institutions <Presidential Decree No. 21241, December 31, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on January 1, 2009.

Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) through (8) Omitted.
(9) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Direct Use of Revenues, etc. of Overseas Diplomatic Missions shall be amended as follows:
In Article 1 (1), the portion of paragraph (2) of the same Article other than its subparagraphs, and Articles 2 and 3, "Minister of Foreign Affairs" shall in each case be replaced with "Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade".
(10) through (13) Omitted.

Addendum <Presidential Decree No. 23671, March 21, 2012>
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Addendum to the Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Its Affiliated Institutions <Presidential Decree No. 24424, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 through 7
Omitted.

Article 8 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) through (9) Omitted.
(10) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Direct Use of Revenues, etc. of Overseas Diplomatic Missions shall be amended as follows:
In Article 2 (1), the portion of Article 2 (2) other than its subparagraphs, and Articles 3 and 4, "Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade" shall in each case be replaced with "Minister of Foreign Affairs".
(11) through (22) Omitted.
